featured_reviews.name: Sonal Goel
featured_reviews.review_text:
First of all this guy won't let you ride any cycles . It's a cycle shop , how else are you going to decide. This annoying fact kept aside the owner is incredibly rude , but still I bought a brand new costly cycle from him ,coz of the closeness of the shop from my resident, after due diligence. I went to some other store to test ride the cycle first and then bought it from bharat cycle company. Since I only got to ride the cycle after I exited the shop once the full payment was done I discovered that the cycle is hugely faulty and is missing a major feature. I had only crossed the nearest red light when I took a U turn and came back to shop.
I informed the owner about this defect and he said that it's not a defect it's how the cycle is made. I tried my best to inform him that he is wrong in for his own benefit, showed him online review videos but still he won't give up and then very rudely told me u give me the cycle back and take your money. I told him that he can give me a fresh piece and that this piece is faulty but he wouldn't budge. He knew he had given me a faulty piece and when I found it out he took the cycle back lest I make a scene.
Very very bad experience overall. Felt like I was robbed in broad day light
I finally bought the cycle in perfect condition with all the features at a much lower price.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My sister selected cycle from this shop and baught it... but cycle was damaged had so many scratches on it. That time owner said in that he had only one piece after 2-3 days they stock will come will deliver u fresh piece (cycle) on extra cost with proper packings. So my sister said ok n paid rs 350/- for delivery. On Sunday he supposed to deliver which he didn't. Very next day he delivered cycle without proper packing n that too damaged cycle which had so many scratches on it....my sister was not ready to accept delivery as it was damaged piece she called shop n told them so they were saying in transport aise hi hota hai....aap ko agar change karna hai to aap lekar aayiye. My sis told him I had already told u to send fresh piece but still u sent damaged piece which was in the shop. Owner said u bring it here I will pay u to n fro transport charged..and will give you new piece.....however she got convinced and next day we went to shop his staff immediately baught new fresh piece in front of us n said is thik okk....will make it ready.
But Owner was saying damage kaha hai thik to hai cycle.....itna to chalta hai....we said we don't want. .....when we asked him about transportation charges....he said I did not said anything like that....how will I give u....my sister called them many times n spoke to them but not a single person accepting that we made a call....we showed them call log also but still they saying none of them spoke with us n told us we'll pay u transportation charges.....owner was not talking at all n going again n again out of shop he doesn't want to give proper service .....his main concern is only money....n his sister was arguing with us we don't know who spoke to u n making fool to customers.
I will recommend not to buy cycle from them....owner is very very rude....he doesn't give proper service to customers....only money minded.....such a worst experience we had.

featured_reviews.name: Bilal Selia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a bicycle from Arvind Cycle Company in Kalbadevi, and overall it was a satisfactory experience. The staff was helpful in explaining the available models and suggesting options within my budget. They have a decent range of basic and mid-range cycles, especially for daily commuting and general use.

The delivery was quick, and the cycle was assembled on the spot. However, I did notice that minor adjustments in gear shifting and brakes were required after a few days, which is quite common but worth mentioning.

Pricing is reasonable compared to other local shops, and being an authorised dealer gives some confidence regarding product authenticity.

Overall, a good place if you’re looking for an affordable, no-frills bicycle, but for premium or performance bikes, you may need to explore other stores.
